items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There's another picture in Dan Morgenstern's book. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yes.

ctx.x: I have them at home. And -- somebody else was taking pictures that day, you know? But they must have known that this was going to come off. I didn't know until the last minute, you know?
Uh-huh. There's another picture in Dan Morgenstern's book.
